function.name: GetIpForwardTable
function.signature: DWORD WINAPI GetIpForwardTable( MIB_IPFORWARDTABLE *table, ULONG *size, BOOL sort )
function.header_comment:
/******************************************************************
 *    GetIpForwardTable (IPHLPAPI.@)
 *
 * Get the route table.
 *
 * PARAMS
 *  table           [Out]    buffer for route table
 *  size            [In/Out] length of output buffer
 *  sort            [In]     whether to sort the table
 *
 * RETURNS
 *  Success: NO_ERROR
 *  Failure: error code from winerror.h
 */
